name: AttackSlope
description: Detects onsets using an energy-based detection function and characterises the attack slope of each detected onset. Outputs 6 channels: [0] onset trigger, [1] minima-corrected onset time, [2] most recent slope measurement, [3] averaged slope, [4] raw detection function, [5] raw peak-pick function. From sc3-plugins SCMIRUGens (Nick Collins MIR).

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Audio input to analyse

inputs.name: windowsize
inputs.description: Window size in samples for the detection function

inputs.name: peakpicksize
inputs.description: Peak-pick window size for onset detection

inputs.name: leak
inputs.description: Leaky integrator coefficient for the detection function

inputs.name: energythreshold
inputs.description: Minimum energy threshold for an onset candidate

inputs.name: sumthreshold
inputs.description: Summed-energy threshold for confirming an onset

inputs.name: mingap
inputs.description: Minimum number of control periods between onsets (debounce)

inputs.name: numslopesaveraged
inputs.description: Number of past slope measurements to average

name: BeatStatistics
description: Computes statistics over a beat histogram derived from a perceptual onset front-end and 100 leaky-integrator periodicities. Outputs 4 channels: [0] entropy, [1] ratio of largest to second-largest histogram entry, [2] Simpson's diversity, [3] metricity (consistency with integer multiples/divisors of the strongest entry). From sc3-plugins SCMIRUGens.

inputs.name: fft
inputs.description: FFT chain (output of an FFT UGen)

inputs.name: leak
inputs.description: Leaky-integrator coefficient for the periodicity detectors

inputs.name: numpreviousbeats
inputs.description: How many previous beats to consider in the histogram

name: Chromagram
description: Octave chroma-band representation of spectral energy for arbitrary nTET tuning. Buckets FFT bins into n equal divisions of an octave starting at tuningbase, summed across the requested number of octaves. Optional integration over time and per-frame normalisation. The number of output channels equals n (set at construction). From sc3-plugins SCMIRUGens.

inputs.name: fft
inputs.description: FFT chain (output of an FFT UGen)

inputs.name: fftsize
inputs.description: FFT size used to populate the bin lookup tables

inputs.name: n
inputs.description: Equal divisions of an octave (n=12 is 12-TET). Also the number of output channels

inputs.name: tuningbase
inputs.description: Base frequency of chroma index 0 (default ~C1 in 12-TET)

inputs.name: octaves
inputs.description: Number of octaves above tuningbase to consider

inputs.name: integrationflag
inputs.description: If 1, integrate chroma frame-to-frame using coeff. Default 0 (no integration)

inputs.name: coeff
inputs.description: Coefficient of frame-to-frame integration when integrationflag is on

inputs.name: octaveratio
inputs.description: Frequency ratio of one 'octave'. Default 2.0; use 3.0 for Bohlen-Pierce tritave etc.

inputs.name: perframenormalize
inputs.description: If 1, normalise each frame's chroma vector to sum to 1 (volume-independent). Default 0

name: FeatureSave
description: Stores feature vectors to a file in NRT mode (or low-load RT). On each trigger, the current features array is sampled and appended. Use unit commands createfile/closefile to control the file. From sc3-plugins SCMIRUGens. Documented as a builder-only entry because the features input is a variadic array flattened into the input list.

inputs.name: .features(array)
inputs.description: Feature array to sample on each trigger — pass any analysis UGens here

inputs.name: .trig(signal)
inputs.description: Trigger input — must be at least -0.01 to fire (so bufnum 0 from FFT analysis still triggers)

name: KeyClarity
description: Running score of the maximum correlation between a chromagram and 12-TET major/minor key profiles in all transpositions. Higher output means a clearer/unambiguous key. Assumes a 440 Hz concert A reference and a 4096-point FFT (or 8192 at 88.2/96 kHz). From sc3-plugins SCMIRUGens.

inputs.name: chain
inputs.description: FFT chain (4096-point FFT for 44.1/48 kHz, 8192 for 88.2/96 kHz)

inputs.name: keydecay
inputs.description: Seconds for a window's influence on the key estimate to decay by 40 dB

inputs.name: chromaleak
inputs.description: Per-frame chroma leak coefficient; 0.0 = no memory between frames

name: KeyMode
description: Best-correlated key mode classifier between major, minor and chromatic-cluster scales in all transpositions. Output: 0 = major, 1 = minor, 2 = chromatic. Based on chromagram correlation with key profiles. Assumes 440 Hz concert A and 4096-point FFT (8192 at 88.2/96 kHz). From sc3-plugins SCMIRUGens.

inputs.name: chain
inputs.description: FFT chain (4096-point FFT for 44.1/48 kHz, 8192 for 88.2/96 kHz)

inputs.name: keydecay
inputs.description: Seconds for a window's influence on the mode estimate to decay by 40 dB

inputs.name: chromaleak
inputs.description: Per-frame chroma leak coefficient; 0.0 = no memory between frames

name: OnsetStatistics
description: Records onset triggers and their times within a sliding time window and produces basic statistics. Outputs 3 channels: [0] density (count of triggers in window), [1] mean inter-onset-interval (seconds), [2] standard deviation of IOIs. From sc3-plugins SCMIRUGens.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Control-rate trigger input — each non-zero value is recorded as an onset

inputs.name: windowsize
inputs.description: Operating window size in seconds (counted backward from now)

inputs.name: hopsize
inputs.description: Hop size in seconds (currently unused — re-calculates every block)

name: SensoryDissonance
description: Perceptual sensory-dissonance / roughness measure based on pairs of prominent spectral peaks. Implements the model in Sethares (1998) 'Consonance-Based Spectral Mappings'. In default settings the output is roughly 0.0 to 1.0. From sc3-plugins SCMIRUGens.

inputs.name: fft
inputs.description: FFT chain (output of an FFT UGen, default size 2048)

inputs.name: maxpeaks
inputs.description: Maximum number of spectral peaks to detect (initialisation only)

inputs.name: peakthreshold
inputs.description: Minimum spectral power to qualify as a peak

inputs.name: norm
inputs.description: Normalisation factor — defaults to 0.01/maxpeaks (auto-computed in SC class). Tweak together with maxpeaks for alternative output ranges

inputs.name: clamp
inputs.description: Clamp value applied to very high dissonance scores (default keeps output in 0..1)

name: SpectralEntropy
description: Spectral entropy across a configurable number of sub-bands. With one band, gives a measure of overall spectral peakiness; with more bands, gives one entropy value per band (number of output channels = numbands). See Toh, Togneri & Nordholm 'Spectral Entropy as Speech Features for Speech Recognition'. From sc3-plugins SCMIRUGens.

inputs.name: fft
inputs.description: FFT chain (output of an FFT UGen)

inputs.name: fftsize
inputs.description: FFT size used for sub-band pre-calculation

inputs.name: numbands
inputs.description: Number of sub-bands (also the number of output channels). Clamped to fftsize
